_note: SEED rows ("seed": true) are illustrative placeholders describing the SHAPE of the corpus, NOT a finalized held-out eval set. Each row is query -> expected memory TITLE(s), NOT live ids (ids are environment-specific and must never be invented). Before the Wave-P embedder flip (AC-023), the OPERATOR must EXPAND this with real HELD-OUT rows ("heldOut": true) drawn from the LIVE corpus using verbatim titles, then freeze it — see ../retune.md step 4. The DB-backed runner in recall.helper.ts matches searchMemory() hits to `relevantTitles` by exact, case-insensitive title equality, so placeholder seed titles will score 0 against a real corpus until replaced. The per-row `seed`/`heldOut` flags mark provenance; the loader ignores them (only { query, relevantTitles } is required).
_split: All rows below are SEED. The held-out set is empty until the operator adds heldOut rows post-backfill; the recall-gate test skips while embedding_v2 is unpopulated, so the seed placeholders never gate falsely.
